metadata.title: Ester student-facing warning wording (Column C questions, Column E remediations)

source_documents.name: NJIT Thesis Auditor Formatting Rules (Google Sheet)
source_documents.note: Live sheet required Google sign-in during extraction; mirror plus task email used.

metadata.scope_note: Only rules with clear, directly mappable Column C/E text in this pass. Broad atomic-split rules (P014, P015, P017, P018) are deferred.

P011.question: Is all text (including tables and figures) contained entirely within the required page margins?
P011.remediation: Set left margin to 1.5 inches and top, bottom, and right margin to 1 inch.
P011.source_note: P011 example from Ester's latest email; extends tracked mirror wording with tables/figures.

P012.question: Does the PDF contain annotations/comments?
P012.source_note: ester_p_rule_feedback.json proposed edits; question unchanged from catalog.

P013.question: Are all visible page numbers located exactly in the designated bottom-center position?
P013.remediation: Set page numbers on the bottom of the page, centered and 0.5 inches from margin

P019.question: Do visible page numbers show inconsistent style, position, or sequence across the document?
P019.remediation: Review page-number placement and numbering style for each section: front matter should use lowercase Roman numerals in sequence; the main body should use Arabic numerals starting at 1.
P019.source_note: project_added_rules.json catalog; no separate P019 row in ester_p_rule_feedback.json.

P021.question: Does the abstract exceed the NJIT word-count limit for the detected degree type?
P021.remediation: Shorten the abstract to within the applicable limit. PhD: ≤400 words. MS: ≤200 words.
P021.source_note: project_added_rules.json catalog; detector limits updated 2026-09-22 to match Ester's sheet (PhD 400 / MS 200), see docs/status/ester_policy_review_p021_p026.md.

P026.question: Does the body text use Times New Roman 12pt (or an accepted equivalent)?
P026.remediation: Word users: set body text to Times New Roman or Arial at 12pt. Overleaf/LaTeX users: Computer Modern or Latin Modern are accepted body fonts.
P026.source_note: project_added_rules.json plus web_app PDF-facing remediation override.

P035.question: Do body-page figure/table floats appear centered with captions in the expected position?
P035.remediation: Center figure/table body blocks within the text area; place table captions above the table body and figure captions below the figure body per NJIT formatting guidance.

P036.question: Is there visible double spacing or a blank line between consecutive TOC, List of Tables, or List of Figures entries?
P036.remediation: Add visible double spacing or a blank line between consecutive entries in the TOC, List of Tables, or List of Figures.

P040.question: Does every figure description in the List of Figures end with terminal punctuation?
P040.remediation: Add terminal punctuation, such as a period, question mark, or exclamation point, to every figure description in the List of Figures.

P053.question: Are all List of Tables entries free of a final period?
P053.remediation: Remove the final period from each List of Tables entry. Table titles should use title case without terminal punctuation.

P054.question: Are all Table of Contents entries free of a final period?
P054.remediation: Remove the final period from each Table of Contents entry.

P068.question: Does the Approval Page include committee role labels and signature/date structural blocks for committee entries?
P068.remediation: Ensure the Approval Page includes an advisor-role label and sufficient date/signature structural blocks for each committee entry. Manual review is still required for honorifics and rank order.
P068.source_note: project_added_rules.json question; remediation composed from catalog notes (no proposed edit in ester_p_rule_feedback.json).
